reading: This is a type-specimen landing page: a header bar, a giant 'VARIABLE' word-mark with per-letter weight/size variation, a hollow-outlined '100—900' heading, a tilted red-orange marquee band repeating 'ONE FILE · EVERY WEIGHT', a weight slider (track + handle dot) labeled 'WEIGHT 100 — 900', and an intro paragraph about the variable font.

Full-bleed decorative marquee band tilted 6° anticlockwise, bleeding off both left and right page edges. Band itself is 1500x86px before tilt (only 86px thick),
Weight-axis slider control: a thin horizontal track rendered as a solid near-black rule exactly 2px tall (h-[2px], not h-2) and 520px wide, with a small 22px ne
Small 13px wide-letter-spaced label beneath the slider reading 'WEIGHT 100 ——— 900', near-black, Helvetica.
Intro paragraph copy, two lines, near-black Helvetica text: 'A variable family with weight and width axes. Drag the slider, the specimen breathes.'
